name: LeRobot 0.7 adds four world action models
title: LeRobot 0.7 adds four world action models
summary: LeRobot 0.7 can load four world action models that predict what happens next and then act. Cosmos3 ships as 16.5B Nano and 4.6B Edge with a 97.9% LIBERO average, and Edge runs on one GPU. FLUX 3 Action is an open 7B diffusion transformer with an SO-101 checkpoint. LaWAM scores 98.5% on LIBERO and Long-WAM, using 19.2 seconds of video history, scores 99.0%, both measured in LeRobot.

appearances.title: LeRobot 0.7 adds four world-action models
appearances.summary: LeRobot 0.7 adds four world-action models that predict what happens next and then act: NVIDIA Cosmos3 (16.5B Nano and 4.6B Edge), Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Action (open 7B), RLinf LaWAM, and NVIDIA Long-WAM. Reported LIBERO averages are 97.9% for Cosmos3, 98.5% for LaWAM, and 99.0% for Long-WAM. Cosmos3 Edge runs on one GPU, and Long-WAM conditions on 19.2 seconds of video history.
